pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Udāyi araññe viharati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.3: tassāyasmato vihāro abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā itthiyo ārāmaṃ āgamaṃsu vihārapekkhikāyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.5: atha kho tā itthiyo yenāyasmā Udāyi ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.7: icchāma mayaṃ bhante ayyassa vihāraṃ pekkhitun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.8: atha kho āyasmā Udāyi tā itthiyo vihāraṃ pekkhāpetvā tāsaṃ itthīnaṃ vaccamaggaṃ passāvamaggaṃ ādissa vaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati avaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati yācati pi āyācati pi pucchati pi paṭipucchati pi ācikkhati pi anusāsati pi akkosati pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.9: yā tā itthiyo chinnikā dhuttikā ahirikāyo tā āyasmatā Udāyinā saddhiṃ ūhasanti pi ullapanti pi ujjhagganti pi uppaṇḍenti pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.10: yā pana tā itthiyo hirimanā tā nikkhamitvā bhikkhū ujjhāpenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.11: idaṃ bhante na cchannaṃ na paṭirūpaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.1.12: sāmikena pi mayaṃ evaṃ vuttā na iccheyyāma, kiṃ pan' ayyena Udāyinā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.2: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Udāyi mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.3: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.4: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.5: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Udāyi mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.8: ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.9: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāsissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.10: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena virāgāya dhammo desito no sarāgāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.12: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.13: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:1.2.14.1: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methunupasaṃhitāhi, saṃghādiseso 'ti. ||2||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.8: rattaṃ pi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ duṭṭhaṃ pi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ mūḷhaṃ pi cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ;
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.9: api ca rattaṃ cittaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetaṃ vipariṇatan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.11: manussitthi, na yakkhī na petī na tiracchānagatā, viññū paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhullāduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:2.17: daharo dahariṃ taruṇo taruṇiṃ kāmabhogo kāmabhogiṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.1.1: dve magge ādissa vaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati avaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati yācati pi āyācati pi pucchati pi paṭipucchati pi ācikkhati pi anusāsati pi akkosati pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.1.7: dehi me arahasi me dātun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.1.21: puṭṭho bhaṇati evaṃ dehi, evaṃ dentā sāmikassa piyā bhavissasi manāpā cā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.1.23: apuṭṭho bhaṇati evaṃ dehi, evaṃ dentā sāmikassa piyā bhavissasi manāpā cā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.2.1: itthi ca hoti, itthisaññī sāratto ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.2.2: bhikkhu canaṃ itthiyā vaccamaggaṃ passāvamaggaṃ ādissa vaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati avaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati . . . akkosati pi, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.2.4.1: dve itthiyo, dvinnaṃ itthīnaṃ itthisaññī sāratto ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.2.8.1: itthi ca paṇḍako ca, ubhinnaṃ itthisaññī sāratto ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.3.1: itthi ca hoti, itthisaññī sāratto ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.3.2: bhikkhu canaṃ itthiyā vaccamaggaṃ passāvamaggaṃ ṭhapetvā adhakkhakaṃ ubbhajānumaṇḍalaṃ ādissa vaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati avaṇṇaṃ pi bhaṇati --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.4.1: itthi ca hoti, itthisaññī sāratto ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.4.2: bhikkhu canaṃ itthiyā ubbhakkhakaṃ adhojānumaṇḍalaṃ ādissa vaṇṇaṃ pi . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.5.1: itthi ca hoti, itthisaññī sāratto ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:3.5.2: bhikkhu canaṃ itthiyā kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ ādissa vaṇṇam pi . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi navarattaṃ kambalaṃ pārutā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.1.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.1.6: tassa kukkuccaṃ ahosi: kacci nu kho ahaṃ saṃghādisesaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi kharakambalaṃ pārutā . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi navāvutaṃ kambalaṃ pārutā . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi kharakambalaṃ pārutā . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.5.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi pāvāraṃ pārutā . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.6.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi khettaṃ vapāpetvā āgacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.6.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.6.5: ām' ayya no ca kho paṭivuttan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.7.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu paribbājikaṃ paṭipathe passitvā sāratto taṃ paribbājikaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.8.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sāratto aññataraṃ itthiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.8.3: api ca yaṃ sāmikassa desi taṃ n' amhākaṃ desīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.9.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sāratto aññataraṃ itthiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.9.3: api ca yaṃ aggadānaṃ taṃ n' amhākaṃ desīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.10.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi kammaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss3:4.10.2: aññataro bhikkhu sāratto taṃ itthiṃ etad avoca:
